name: 機能語分布
description: 分析します the 分布 of 機能語 (articles, prepositions, conjunctions) as stylistic fingerprints to distinguish AI from 人間のテキスト.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal function word usage パターン that reflect unconscious 文体
mechanism: 抽出します and quantifies 機能語 (determiners, prepositions, conjunctions, auxiliary verbs, 代名詞s) は constitute ~50% of typical English text. These 'style words' are produced largely unconsciously by humans and carry strong authorial fingerprints. The method computes relative frequencies of 300+ 機能語 and compares 分布s using Burrows's Delta distance metric. AI生成の text shows 統計的ly distinct function word profiles from 人間のテキスト.
source: Burrows, J. F. (2002) - Delta: A Measure of Stylistic Difference, Literary and Linguistic Computing
algorithm: Function Word Extraction + Burrows's Delta + Kilgarriff's Chi-Squared
parameters: Function word list: 300+ closed-class words, Metric: Burrows's Delta, z-score normalization, Granularity: per-paragraph, Reference: balanced human corpus
strengths:
• Grounded in decades of computational stylistics research
• Function words are difficult to consciously control
• Robust にわたる topics and domains
• Well-understood 統計的 framework
limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length (>200 words)
• May not distinguish 間の different human authors vs AI
• Language-specific function word lists needed
• Modern LLMs increasingly match human 分布s

references.title: Burrows, J. F. (2002). Delta: A Measure of Stylistic Difference and Its Literary History. Literary and Linguistic Computing.
